description:
Resolve and close the existing request 'Network connectivity down on 3rd floor'. 

1. Open the request.
2. Add the following Resolution: "Root cause identified as a failed network switch (Cisco Catalyst 2960-X) in IDF closet 3B. The switch was experiencing a firmware crash loop after an automatic update at 02:00 AM. Resolution steps: 1) Connected via console cable and rolled back firmware to version 15.2(7)E3. 2) Verified port connectivity restored for all 48 ports. 3) Disabled automatic firmware updates pending change approval. 4) Scheduled replacement switch under warranty RMA case #SR-2024-88712."
3. Log 'Time Spent' as 2 hours and 15 minutes.
4. Change the status to 'Resolved'.
